title: Paxos closing band
description: A full-bleed 534px band (305px on phones) of faint light: white at the top melting into a pale aqua on the left and a pale lime at the bottom-right, with a centred two-line 32px title and a pair of pills (slate and outline). On phones the title and pills sit left. Static.
notes: the wash is built from the theme's glow and highlight; a backdrop image can replace it
